notes.title: Character Update and UI Remaster
notes.notes:
Updates!!

All 5 teachers have been updated to new, better looking sprites.
We have also fixed some rarely occurring bugs with the music, and room-to-room transfers. 
We have also updated the title, characters, and options screens with new, made-from-scratch designs.
Finally, there have been several dialogue and QoL updates to clear things up and make for a better experience.

[b]Nyanko Games[/b] has evolved a lot since this game was originally released, both in game creation and Japanese fluency. That is why we are proud to announce that this update is being released to celebrate the beginning of a new, modernized language learning app!

The new game will contain all of Hiragana, Katakana, and common Kanji, along with vocabulary and sentence structure. All material will be taught following the teaching pattern on the famous Genki 1 Japanese learning textbox series.

The new game will also be presented on both mobile and desktop devices, featured with updated graphics, RPG game elements, a world to explore, and a story to uncover.

Join us at our [url=discord.gg/vbsg2QD]discord[/url] to learn more about our future projects, or to report issues or suggestions regarding any of our games.

Thank you all and have a wonderful day ^_^

notes.title: Small Bugfix Update!
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with DLC not working correctly, and steam achievements not working for everyone.

Both are now fully working, upon opening the game for the first time you should now get the "Getting Started' achievement to show it has been fixed.

To select your DLC character, go to options, characters, and click on the desired character. 

Finally, the last character is currently on it's way, and 2 out of the 3 are added in now and fully functioning ^_^

We also did a couple of hot fixes and performance updates. Let us know if you have any issues with this build, or any suggestions. Thank you!

notes.title: Release is here!
notes.notes:
Hiya! The official release is finally here, I thank you all for your patience!

Unfortunately we are still awaiting word from Valve about the DLC characters, so they will each come out as soon as possible (likely within a day or two).
In the meantime, the base game is playable, and we will be working hard to push out some bug fix and improvement updates soon.

With that said, do let us know if you have any suggestions or find any bugs that need to be addressed, you can reach us at nyankogamingdev@gmail.com OR www.reddit.com/r/nyankogaming.

Thank you again for your patience, we're gonna get to work on those updates, and other projects we have planned!

Happy playing ~~♡

notes.title: Slight Delay in project Release Date
notes.notes:
Hiya ! Game dev here, unfortunately I have to delay the release of this title by about 6 days. This is due to some unforeseen complications in the initial release build, that will take a couple days time to fix.

Along with this though, I am also implementing some things I originally planned to push through in an update. This means there will be more things in the release day build than expected, including: 

• A fully working music player to pause/play/skip songs
• Multiple background colors that can be chosen from options
• Chapter selection screen that updates as you complete chapters
• A special extras section awarded after character completion
• Some under-the-hood fixes and optimizations

Bear with us for one more week and we hope you look forward to the release!
